title: Automatic Refills at the Home Delivery Pharmacy: Training Note
content:
## Training note: automatic refills

**Rule.** Where the program offers automatic refills, the member may enroll in automatic refills; an enrolled prescription is placed as an automatic refill order when the program's automatic-refill lead days of supply remain, provided a fill remains and the prescription has not expired. Drugs on the program's automatic-refill exclusion list are never refilled automatically. Enrollment and withdrawal are recorded only at the member's own request, and preferences may be changed only while the account is registered, active or on hold.

### Questions answered

**Who decides whether a prescription is on automatic refills?** The member. Enrollment and withdrawal are recorded only at the member's own request.

**When is an automatic refill order placed?** When the program's lead days of supply remain on the enrolled prescription, and only if a fill remains and the prescription has not expired.

**Can every drug be refilled automatically?** No. A drug on the program's exclusion list (oxycodone-acetaminophen under every Home Delivery Pharmacy program) is never refilled automatically.

**Can preferences be changed on a closed account?** No. Preferences may be changed only while the account is registered, active or on hold.

### Conditions for an automatic refill order

| Enrolled | Lead days of supply remain | Fill remaining | Not expired | Drug not excluded | Automatic refill order placed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | No | any | any | No |
| Yes | Yes | any | No | any | No |
| Yes | Yes | any | any | No | No |

### Hypothetical case

An enrolled 90-day prescription on a program with a 14-day lead is placed as an automatic refill order when 14 days of supply remain, provided it still has a fill remaining and has not expired.
